_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/mana/test_add_mana_on_tap_chosen_color.py. t_cs_caged_sun is Caged Sun's third line alone ('whenever a land's ability causes you to add one or more mana of the chosen color, add an additional one mana of that color') -- tapped_permanent {'types': ['Land'], 'produced': {'chosen_color_of': 'self'}, 'any_mana_ability': true}. t_cs_tap_only is the same sentence without any_mana_ability ('whenever you tap a land for mana of the chosen color'), so the two are shown to differ on a mana ability that does not tap.
